chunks: Yunus narrated from Sama'ah, who said:

When the thief is apprehended, his hand is cut from the middle of the palm. If he returns, his foot is cut from the middle of the foot. If he returns, he is committed to prison. Then if he steals in prison, he is killed.

key_terms.السَّارِقُ: the thief; the person guilty of theft
key_terms.قُتِلَ: he was killed; the final penalty mentioned here
key_terms.قُطِعَ: was cut; refers here to judicial amputation as punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhib al-Ahkam on repeated theft and the punishment of a thief?
ai.summary: This hadith sets out a graded legal punishment for repeated theft, beginning with amputation of the hand, then the foot, then imprisonment, and finally execution if theft is committed again in prison. It reflects a jurisprudential ruling concerning criminal punishment within the Shia legal tradition.
